title: Senior Data Center Engineer
description:
OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
Seeking High-level technical Data Center Engineer is responsible for maintaining reliability, and technical integration of complex electrical infrastructure and HVAC systems that support 24/7 mission-critical operations. This role includes firsthand overseeing power infrastructure from the utility grid down to the individual server racks.
  
  
WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS
  
  

* Architecture: Own end-to-end design of power systems, including dual power fed high-reliability substation, medium-to-low voltage distribution, and uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems.
* Infrastructure Management: Supervise critical equipment such as generators, switchgear, transformers, automatic transfer switches, and UPS systems.
* Project Leadership: Work with vendors approving work, managing projects, and overseeing electricians.
* Maintain DC mechanical infrastructure: Identify issues and work with vendors approving work, managing projects, and overseeing maintenance activities.
* Sustainability Integration: Investigate and implement renewable energy sources and carbon-free technologies into the facility's power architecture.
